purpose: Track promising Travelpayouts catalog programs separately from ERN-approved/unlocked programs so platform availability is never confused with owner-project access.
evidenceBasis: Official Travelpayouts Help Center: platform includes flights, hotels/accommodation, transfers, tours, insurance, car rentals and other travel services.
Official Travelpayouts documentation: Projects are automatically connected only to relevant programs; some are instant, some require review, and some may remain unavailable.
Official Travelpayouts brand directory / program pages reviewed 2026-10-06.

accommodation.why: Broad global accommodation coverage; potentially useful after a visitor chooses a destination.
accommodation.officialEvidence: Travelpayouts accommodation catalog currently lists Booking.com with hotel and other travel products.
accommodation.placementRule: One accommodation action per destination context by default; never compete with Earth discovery.

accommodation.why: Global lodging inventory with a Travelpayouts program page and link-generation workflow.
accommodation.officialEvidence: Travelpayouts currently exposes a Hotels.com Partner Program for accommodations.
accommodation.placementRule: Use only if owner project access exists and destination deep-linking is clean; suppress if another lodging partner is clearly better.

accommodation.why: Potentially useful multi-vertical option for hotels, flights, trains, attractions and transfers.
accommodation.officialEvidence: Travelpayouts official 2026 reward documentation lists Trip.com hotel, flight, train, attraction, experience, transfer and car-rental categories.
accommodation.placementRule: Use only for a distinct visitor need; avoid duplicating separate stronger programs.

accommodation.why: Strong lodging candidate, especially in Asia, if ERN project access is available.
accommodation.officialEvidence: Travelpayouts official 2026 reward documentation lists Agoda.
accommodation.placementRule: Accommodation only after destination choice; exact owner-side availability and link required.

accommodation.why: Broad travel inventory can fill accommodation/package gaps if owner access exists.
accommodation.officialEvidence: Travelpayouts official 2026 reward documentation lists Expedia.
accommodation.placementRule: Prefer destination-specific deep links and avoid generic homepage actions.

accommodation.officialEvidence: Travelpayouts official 2026 reward documentation lists Rakuten Travel for Japan hotel and car-rental bookings.
accommodation.placementRule: Japan-focused use only where owner access and destination deep links are verified.

transport.why: Useful for trains, buses, ferries and regional transport, especially in Asia.
transport.placementRule: Use only for explicit intercity/island transport planning after destination choice.

transport.why: Flight-search alternative for remote destinations and trip-planning contexts.
transport.officialEvidence: Travelpayouts platform documentation uses Aviasales as a supported program example.
transport.placementRule: One flight-search action per trip-planning context; never on camera cards.

activities.why: Potential complement where Klook/Viator inventory is weak or materially different.
activities.officialEvidence: Travelpayouts official 2026 reward documentation lists GetYourGuide.
activities.placementRule: Do not duplicate an existing stronger activity action without clear incremental visitor value.

carRental.why: Broad global car-rental inventory could improve coverage where ERN's currently unlocked rental programs are weak.
carRental.officialEvidence: Travelpayouts' current-accessible advertiser/car-rental overview lists Rentalcars.com as a car-rental program with links/widgets.
carRental.placementRule: Research only until Earthrightnow Project availability and exact destination deep-link support are confirmed; choose at most one rental option per destination cluster.

carRental.why: Potential broad car-rental alternative for island/road-trip destinations if the program remains available to Earthrightnow.
carRental.officialEvidence: Travelpayouts' car-rental program materials continue to document Discover Cars; owner-side current Program Catalog status must be checked before ERN treats it as available.
carRental.placementRule: Do not activate from public documentation alone. Verify current owner-project access, exact destination coverage and tracked-link generation; suppress against a clearer existing rental partner.

nextOwnerResearch: In Travelpayouts Earthrightnow Project > My Programs, check whether Booking.com, Hotels.com, Trip.com, Agoda, Expedia, Rakuten Travel, 12Go, Aviasales and GetYourGuide are Available, Under Review or Unavailable.
For any available program, test one representative ERN destination deep link before creating public placement.
Record exact owner-side status and only then graduate a program into travelpayouts-unlocked-programs.json.

platformCheckpoint2026.marketplace: Travelpayouts currently advertises 90+ trusted brands and broad service families including transport, accommodation, tours/activities, insurance, packages and cruises.
platformCheckpoint2026.connectionModel: Since 2026-04-27, projects are automatically connected to relevant programs when available; some tools/programs are instant, some require review, and some can remain unavailable.
platformCheckpoint2026.deepLinkRule: Travelpayouts Links can generate partner deep links to specific brand pages only after the program is available to the selected Project.
platformCheckpoint2026.ernRule: Catalog presence is research evidence only. Owner-project availability, exact destination coverage, generated tracked link and manual verification remain mandatory before public activation.
